Thanks for the ping — summary and recommended customer-facing text below. I copied the minimal evidence checklist for the TIA (we can export as PDF).

Short position for customer (1-2 sentences):
Redwood will provide the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) as the baseline for cross-border transfers. For UK-resident data, we will offer the UK Addendum/IDTA as an optional addendum when customers require a direct contractual mapping to UK transfer rules; in practice, we recommend adding the UK Addendum when the volume or regulatory sensitivity of UK data is material to the account or when the customer's legal team insists on a single contractual bundle.

Operational note:
- SCCs are included in our standard DPA for hosted and dedicated customers. The UK Addendum can be executed as an additional signature package (takes ~3-5 business days once legal review is complete).
- If the customer prefers not to execute the UK Addendum immediately, we provide a documented mitigation package (technical controls + documented processing boundaries) and commit to an optional addendum window during the contract term.

Minimum TIA evidence checklist (we should attach this):
- Data flow diagram (CSV/diagram) showing cross-border hops and origin countries.
- Subprocessor map (current snapshot; CSV).
- Sample retention schedule for the products in-scope.
- List of SKUs/features that will process EU/UK personal data.
- Any additional encryption/KMS requirements or HSM/KMS ARNs.

Pricing/lead time:
- SCCs only: no pricing change.
- SCCs + UK Addendum: no baseline price change; legal/AM time to execute may influence go-live timeline (estimate 3–7 business days from countersignature availability).

Suggested customer reply (pasteable):

Hi Sofía — thanks for the great questions and the call earlier. Short answers first, then the attachments and next steps.

1) Will Redwood include the UK Addendum by default?
No — SCCs are included by default in our DPA. The UK Addendum (IDTA) is offered as an addendum for accounts that need it. Given what you described (a small subset of UK resident data), our recommendation is to start with SCCs and run the TIA scoping sprint; if your legal team requires the IDTA after scoping, we can append it without changing data flows.

2) If you sign SCCs only, what additional controls do you get?
We provide a documented mitigation package that includes:
- Explicit transfer boundary documentation in the TIA.
- KV/prefix caching policies and region pinning for UK-origin requests where feasible.
- Audit log excerpts and retention commitments included in the evidence package.

3) What we need from you to scope the TIA:
- Data flow diagram (origin countries and third-party hops) — please upload to the shared Drive link below.
- Current subprocessor snapshot (CSV) — attach to email or use the secure file upload link.
- Retention schedule and list of SKUs/features that will be in-scope.

Attached: Redwood_TIA_Scope_v1.pdf (scoping template) and subprocessor_map_bancolatam.csv (attachment stub). I also included Laura's one-page checklist.
